newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KILLER OF APARTHEID ARCHITECT VERWOERD TAKES ILL.
newsitem.headline: KILLER OF APARTHEID ARCHITECT VERWOERD TAKES ILL.

text.p: A disturbed man who turned into a bizarre 1960s hero for apartheid's victims by killing South African premier Hendrik Verwoerd at a tapeworm's behest, has been taken to hospital after falling physically ill.
A Johannesburg hospital confirmed on Thursday that Demetrio Tsafendas, 78, was admitted at the weekend after succumbing to pneumonia and severe dehydration at his psychiatric institute.
A paranoid schizophrenic who worked as a parliamentary messenger, he stabbed to death the man who designed apartheid in the House of Assembly in 1966.
He never stood trial and escaped the gallows because he was declared insane, insisting a tape worm made him do it.
Tsafendas spent nearly two decades in jail until he was moved to a psychiatric home west of Johannesburg in 1994.
Hospital officials said Tsafendas, who says the worms still plague him, was refusing to take fluids voluntarily but had been fed intravenously and his physical health was improving.
